text: Run every check in the proving pipeline to completion for every change: never skip, filter, sample, or partial-run a gate, and before any done/green/passing claim run the FULL command (fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, the complete test suite, and any artifact-specific check) fresh and read each exit code — a subset run is not a pass.

Never release or claim shipped until the actual shipped path is verified end-to-end in a real environment: exercise the real command, hook, agent, or install live, treat green unit/CI as necessary but not sufficient, and flag any path that cannot be run live as unverified instead of claiming it works.
